newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS SOFTER - MOGAS BARGES OFF $9.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS SOFTER - MOGAS BARGES OFF $9.

text.p: NWE oil products were softer on Thursday as crude futures fell sharply, traders said.
Mogas came down almost as fast as it rose in recent days, with barge deals at $228 and $230, $9 lower than Wednesday.
Gas oil lost nearly $3.00 a tonne as IPE futures dropped. Activity was slow, hindered by the continued strong dollar.

High sulphur fuel oil barges eased a little to trade at $94 fob ARA with traders saying loading delays were solved at two storage sites. Russian cargoes, cracked and straight-run, continued to be offered strong but no serious bids were seen.
